title: Hotel Cancellation Policy
body:
Princess Hotel

Cancellation Policy

  • Until 30 days prior to arrival, in case of cancellation no penalty charges will be applied.
  • From 29 to 15 days before arrival, any individual cancellation will be billed at 50% of the stay reserved.
  • From 14 days to arrival, any individual cancellation will be billed at 100% of the stay reserved.
  • Any "no-shows" (guaranteed rooms that are not occupied on the day of arrival) shall be invoiced on the basis of 100% of the stay.

SB Diagonal Zero

Prepayment Policy

  • Prepayment required: 1 nights: By credit card (we will charge it prior to arrival)*

Cancellation Policy

  • Cancellation of the booking confirmation 30day prior to the arrival date: 1 night will be charged to the guest credit card.
  • Cancellation between 29 days and 10 days before arrival date: 2 nights will be charged to the guest credit card.
  • Cancellation less than 10 days prior to the arrival date. The total stay will be charged to the guest credit card.
  • In case of no show, reduction of nights, early and late check out (based on property local time): 100% of stay will be charged.

* Hotel SB Diagonal Zero reserves its right to check the validity of your credit card before your arrival.

Vincci Maritimo

Cancellation Policy

  • If cancel within 24 Hour(s) before arrival or guest is no show, 1 Night(s) will be charged as cancellation penalty

Vincci Bit

Cancellation Policy

  • If cancel within 24 Hour(s) before arrival or guest is no show, 1 Night(s) will be charged as cancellation penalty

Tryp Condal Mar

Cancellation Policy

  • If you cancel between 30 day(s) & 14 day(s) before arrival: 1 night(s) charge as cancellation penalty will apply
  • If you cancel between 14 day(s) & 7 day(s) before arrival: 2 night(s) charge as cancellation penalty will apply
  • If you cancel 7 day(s) before arrival or are a no-show, 100 % charge as cancellation penalty will apply

Barcelo Atenea Mar

Cancellation Policy

  • Cancellation made with less than 2 day(s) in advance 100% of total amount of the booking
  • Cancellation made with more than 2 day(s) in advance 0€
  • No shows before 18:00 hrs on the booked day of arrival shall be charged the amount corresponding to 100% of the total booking. Notify the hotel if you foresee this circumstance.

Melia Sky

Cancellation Policy

  • If you cancel 7 day(s) before arrival or are a no-show, 100 % charge as cancellation penalty will apply

Silken Diagonal

Cancellation Policy

  • When the hotel receives your reservation, the total amount will be charged on your card. No refund will be made in case of cancellation, early departure or no-show (the reservation is kept up to the 1st night). If the charge to your card is denied, the hotel will cancel your reservation.

Payment Policy

  • Prepayment required: 100%: By credit card (we will charge it prior to arrival)

SB Icaria

Cancellation Policy

  • Between the time of the reservation and 30 days: 1 night will be charged
  • Between 29 and 10 days before arrival: 2 nights will be charged
  • No Shows or cancellation with 9 days or less before arrival: Total stay will be charged

Payment Policy

  • Penalty if cancelled - For the reservation to be confirmed, 100% of the total amount will be charged to your credit card. Only then will your automatic confirmation be valid. The amount will not be reimbursed under any circumstances. Hotel SB Icaria Barcelona reserves its right to check the validity of your credit card before your arrival

H10 Marina

Cancellation Policy

  • If you cancel or change your booking before noon on the day before your arrival, we will not apply any charges.
  • For cancellations after this time or no shows, you will be charged for one night according to the type of board originally booked, and any further nights you had booked will be cancelled.

W Hotel Barcelona

Cancellation Policy

  • If you cancel between 06/15/2016 and 6:00 PM hotel time on 10/04/2016, there will be no forfeiture amount.
  • If you cancel after 6:00 PM hotel time on 10/04/2016, the forfeiture amount will be 100.00 percent.

Hilton Diagonal Mar

Rate Conditions

  • Run of the house rooms. Booked room type is not guaranteed and may be changed at any time, including upon check-in.
  • A valid credit card is required for all bookings.
  • All charges to be paid upon check-out.
  • Bookings can be made until the 9th of October.

Cancellation Policy

  • From the time of booking and until 30 days prior to the arrival date: no cancellation fees will be applied.
  • From 29 to 15 days prior to the arrival date: 50% of the amount due for the stay will be charged as a cancellation fee.
  • From 14 days prior to the arrival date and onwards: 100% of the amount due for the stay will be charged as a cancellation fee.
  • In case of no-shows or early departures, all lost nights will be charged as cancellation fees.
  • Please contact us should you need to cancel your reservation.

AC Hotel

Cancellation Policy

  • A non-refundable deposit of one night room an dtax is required at the time of booking.
  • The remaining balance will be charged 15 days before the arrival.
  • Less than 14 days before the arrival, all cancellations will be non-refundable.
archiveNotice: Archived content from the Barcelona 2016 Summit. Dates, policies and instructions on this page apply to that historical event.
